name: patterns-change-playing
about: ENGINE.md §21 (D133; R90: "Pattern changes at the end of bar"; a choice "clear[s] the chain"; "Same when I stop then start"). Three patterns of sixteen steps by edits: 1 a kick on step 1, 2 hats on 1 and 9, 3 a snare on 5; playing pattern 1 from tick 0. Pattern 2 chosen at run step 5: it waits (next=1) and lands at the end of the bar, tick 1536. The chain 3 1 built while playing at 20 (next=20) lands at 3072: pattern 3, then 1 at 4608. Pattern 3 chosen alone at 50 while that chain runs (next=2): at 6144 it replaces the chain, and plays again at 7680. Stopped at 82 and played at 84: pattern 3 alone, from its step 1 (tick 8064). A choice and a chain built while playing land at the end of the bar; nothing lands mid-bar.
